opening.argument: The video presents xCore as a new money-making opportunity and ties income to the viewer’s work, team’s work, and an upliner’s work. The speaker states that xCore “also provides income and takes all necessary positions 50%,” then claims that “every position will be paid 50 %.” The on-screen material likewise says the viewer and upliner will work and earn, while another caption claims the program will earn the viewer 500%. These are promotional earnings claims connected to program positions and participation. The precise payout mechanism and whether any returns occurred remain unestablished.
